name: Chen Chun-Lin
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Shanghai Medicilon Inc. (688202.SS)
profile: Chen Chunlin (陈春麟) earned a pharmacy master's from China Pharmaceutical University (1986) and a PhD in pharmacology/toxicology from Oklahoma State University (1994), worked in US drug metabolism research, then returned to China in early 2004 to found Medicilon, a Shanghai preclinical CRO now listed on the STAR Market.
interesting_fact: Medicilon says it has served 2,000+ biotech/pharma clients and helped about 580 innovative-drug INDs get cleared for clinical trials in China, the US, Australia and the EU.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Medicilon he specialised in pharmacokinetics and metabolism for cardiovascular, anti-HIV and anticancer drugs; he also chairs the biomedicine branch of the Western Returned Scholars Association in Shanghai and won a Shanghai Zhangjiang 'most passionate Pharma Valley person' award (2013).
notes: marketing@ address is the business-inquiry mailbox, not a dedicated press desk; IR mailbox is best for a formal approach. A 2008 PharmAsia News interview with him exists (scrip.citeline.com SC066729).

name: Maurice J Gallagher Jr
current_role: Chairman of the Board, Allegiant Travel Company (ALGT); filings list him as Executive Chairman
profile: Maury Gallagher, born 1950, was a principal of WestAir (sold to Mesa in 1992) and a founding investor/director of ValuJet (1993-97). As the major creditor of bankrupt Fresno-based Allegiant in 2000 he took control, moved it to Las Vegas and built its ultra-low-cost leisure model; CEO 2003-2022 and 2023-2024, chairman since 2006.
interesting_fact: He owns NASCAR's GMS Racing (Truck Series titles in 2016 and 2020) and became co-owner of the Cup team now called Legacy Motor Club, alongside Jimmie Johnson.
deep_cut_fact: Between ValuJet and Allegiant he founded telecom carrier Mpower Communications (IPO 1998); a UC Davis history BA (1971) with a Berkeley MBA, he gave $10M toward UC Davis's Maurice J. Gallagher Jr. Hall and gave its business-school commencement address in 2011.
notes: Retired as CEO Sept 2024 (Greg Anderson succeeded). Allegiant's own board page lists him as 'Chairman of the Board'. Media line +1 702-800-2020 per press releases.

name: Wang Nandong
current_role: Former controlling shareholder/actual controller of Jiangfen Magnetic (Jiangmen), now Guangdong Lingyi iTech (002600.SZ); no current executive role found
profile: Wang Nandong (汪南东), based in Jiangmen, Guangdong, was the original controlling shareholder of Jiangfen Magnetic Materials (SZSE 002600), which after a 2018 reverse merger became Lingyi iTech, a major consumer-electronics components supplier. SZSE filings show his family steadily reducing its stake through 2020.
interesting_fact: The listed company he controlled became Lingyi iTech, which now describes itself as an AI-device hardware supplier (robots, AI glasses, foldables, server cooling).
notes: Hurun 'LY' read as Lingyi (formerly Jiangfen Magnetic); match is from SZSE filings, no biography found. He is no longer tied to Lingyi management, so company IR is not a route to him. 2019 SZSE public censure over share-lock breach; avoid. No public contact found; very low profile.

name: Liao Tengjia
current_role: Deputy Chairman and Executive Director, Zhuguang Holdings Group (1176.HK)
profile: Liao Tengjia (廖腾佳) is a Guangzhou property developer with nearly 30 years in Chinese real estate. He chaired HK-listed Zhuguang Holdings (2009-13), was its CEO (2015-17) and has been deputy chairman since March 2017. A 2022 HKEX filing says he beneficially owns 36% of controlling shareholder Rong De.
interesting_fact: He is one of the ultimate owners of Rong De Investment, controlling shareholder of Zhuguang Holdings; a 2022 HKEX filing put his stake in Rong De at 36%.
notes: Officer history per webb-site.com (officers.asp?p=4922) and HKEX filings. Couldn't load the company website (zhuguang.com.hk) for an IR contact. Low public profile.

name: Cui Jianhua
profile: Listed in Hurun China 2021 as Cui Jianhua (崔建华), logistics, wealth source 'Friend'. Chinese and English searches turned up no company or filing that links this name to a logistics business.
notes: Couldn't identify the company behind 'Friend'. Needs the Chinese company name from the original Hurun entry to go further.

name: Zhang Xiubing
current_role: Co-founding shareholder (with Wan Lili) of Shunya International Martech (300612.SZ); former director; no current executive role (chairman is Ren Xiang)
profile: Zhang Xiubing (张秀兵) and Wan Lili (万丽莉) are listed as the actual controllers of Beijing-based Shunya International (宣亚国际), a PR/marketing agency founded in 2007 and listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in February 2017. He served as a director, and as of Sept 2026 he was still its No. 2 shareholder, holding about 0.9% directly.
interesting_fact: Shunya, a traditional PR agency, has repositioned as 'martech', with digital advertising, data products and 'OrangeGPT' AI marketing tools.
notes: Shareholding and controller data are from Eastmoney F10 (ShareholderResearch). I found no personal biography. Wealth shared with Wan Lili. The IR mailbox is the company's, not his.

name: Mao Shanjun
current_role: Founder, actual controller and Chairman, Beijing LongRuan Technologies (688078.SH); Professor, Peking University
profile: Mao Shanjun (毛善君, b. 1964) is a coal geologist (PhD, China University of Mining and Technology) and a Peking University professor since 1999. In 2002 he founded LongRuan, which builds GIS-based industrial software for coal-mine safety and intelligent mining. It listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in Dec 2019 as the board's first coal-industry software stock.
interesting_fact: He is a professor-founder: he still teaches at Peking University's Institute of Remote Sensing and GIS while chairing a listed company, and is chief scientist (smart mining) at PKU's Ordos Energy Research Institute.
deep_cut_fact: His master's research (1986-89) was in mathematical geology. After it he worked in aerial survey/remote sensing at the China Coal Geology Bureau, then did a PKU postdoc (1997-99) on 'virtual mines' theory, the groundwork for LongRuan's transparent-mine software.
notes: Bio is from the company's disclosed resume via Eastmoney F10. Energy/mining-tech angle fits the podcast well. A PKU faculty page could be another route to him.

name: Liu Chengwei
profile: On Hurun China lists 2006-2013 as Liu Chengwei (刘承玮), real estate, wealth source 'Guanfang'. Searches found no company or source tying this name to a property developer.
notes: Couldn't identify the 'Guanfang' company. He dropped off the list after 2013, so he may no longer be active.

name: Zhang Xiangwen
current_role: Former co-controlling shareholder (with husband Cheng Shangnan) of Changzhou NRB Corporation (002708.SZ); no current executive role found
profile: Zhang Xiangwen (张湘文) and her husband Cheng Shangnan were the actual controllers of Changzhou NRB Corp (光洋股份), a needle/roller and clutch-release bearing maker for car and truck transmissions, founded 1994 and listed in Shenzhen in Jan 2014. Control later passed to Huangshan city's state-asset commission; Cheng still holds about 5%.
interesting_fact: NRB's test centre is one of 11 bearing-industry labs in China with ISO/IEC 17025 national accreditation, and NRB was first drafter of national standards for automotive transmission bearings.
notes: Identity is from the 2013 IPO sponsor letter (disc.static.szse.cn/.../7afdbeab-36cf-495f-8fc5-89485fe03750.PDF), which names Cheng Shangnan and Zhang Xiangwen as the husband-and-wife controllers. The company is now state-controlled, so its IR (bearing@nrb.com.cn) is not a route to her. Very private.

name: Elizabeth H. Wiley
current_role: Manager, E.P. Hamilton Trusts LLC (Wiley family holding vehicle); 10% owner reporting person, John Wiley & Sons (WLY/WLYB)
profile: Elizabeth H. Wiley belongs to the family that controls 200+-year-old publisher John Wiley & Sons. On 6 Sept 2023, for estate planning, she, Jesse C. Wiley and Celia Wiley were made managers of E.P. Hamilton Trusts LLC alongside W. Bradford Wiley II, Deborah Wiley and Peter Booth Wiley. That gives her shared beneficial ownership of the family's 8.1M+ Class B voting shares.
interesting_fact: Her Form 3 shows the family's E.P. Hamilton Trusts LLC holds about 8.1 million Class B shares; their extra voting power for electing directors keeps the Wiley family in control of the publisher.
notes: Known only from SEC filings (Form 3 filed May 2025; Schedule 13D/A). Her stake is shared family-trust ownership, not personal wealth. No public role, biography or contact found. Her exact relationship to other family members isn't stated in the filings.

name: Li Huafeng
current_role: Shareholder of Foshan Haitian Flavouring & Food (603288.SH / 3288.HK) and its parent Haitian Group; no current board or executive role found
profile: Li Huafeng (李华锋) is one of the 58 individuals who owned Guangdong Haitian Group, controlling shareholder of soy-sauce giant Haitian. The 2013 IPO prospectus shows him with about 0.63% of Haitian Group and 1.57M shares (0.22%) held directly in Haitian Flavouring. The company's employee-owner model made dozens of managers wealthy.
interesting_fact: Haitian, whose wealth he shares in, says it runs the world's largest glass-roofed sun-fermentation yards for soy sauce and has been China's No.1 soy-sauce brand in the C-BPI ranking 14 years running.
notes: Shareholding is from the 2013 Haitian IPO prospectus draft (pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN201312110004774202_1.PDF). I couldn't confirm his role at Haitian or any biography. Very low profile; company IR (OBD@haday.cn) is the company's mailbox, not his.

name: Zhang Renhua
current_role: Co-founder and co-actual controller (with husband Han Xu) of Realcan Pharmaceutical Group (002589.SZ); former Vice Chairman and General Manager
profile: Zhang Renhua (张仁华, b. 1966), a trained pharmacist from Yantai, co-founded Realcan with her husband Han Xu. It grew from a Yantai drug-distribution company into a national direct supplier of drugs and medical devices to nearly 60,000 hospitals and clinics, and listed in Shenzhen in June 2011. Han Xu is now chairman and president; she held the vice-chair/GM roles until around 2023.
interesting_fact: At the 2011 IPO she was the largest single shareholder (38.69%), above her husband the chairman (30.58%), and served as vice chairman and general manager.
deep_cut_fact: Before going into business she was a pharmacist and Communist Youth League branch secretary at Yantai Shan Hospital; she also served as a Yantai municipal people's congress deputy.
notes: Wealth shared with husband Han Xu (chairman/president as of Aug 2026). The IR mailbox is the company's board-secretary office.

name: Yang Zijiang
current_role: Former co-controlling shareholder (with father Yang Zewen and brother Yang Zishan) of NanFang Ventilator (300004.SZ); control sold to Nanhai state capital in 2021-22
profile: Yang Zijiang (杨子江) is a member of the Yang family of Foshan that controlled NanFang Ventilator, an HVAC and ventilation maker for nuclear plants, metros and tunnels founded in 1988. It was among the first ChiNext listings in Oct 2009. In Dec 2021 he and his father agreed to sell shares to Guangdong Nanhai Holding, and the company is now state-controlled.
interesting_fact: NanFang Ventilator was the first in its industry licensed by China's National Nuclear Safety Administration to design and make both nuclear-grade fans and dampers, and was among the first 28 ChiNext listings in 2009.
notes: Family relationships and the 2021 share sale per stcn.com (2022-01-04) and Eastmoney/press reports. The family has exited, so company IR (investors@ntfan.com) is not a route to him. Sensitive family/company history after 2018; avoid.

name: Desmond Richard
profile: Likely a merged Rich List entry for the Maybury siblings Desmond and Richard Maybury (with Eleanor Maybury), founders of London's Big Bus Company. They started it in June 1991 with a handful of open-top buses, merged it with Paris's Les Cars Rouges in 2011 to form Big Bus Tours, and sold to Exponent Private Equity in Feb 2015.
interesting_fact: Big Bus began in London in 1991 with three or four buses and grew into a global sightseeing operator in cities such as Dubai, Hong Kong, Paris, New York and Sydney before the 2015 sale.
notes: No source uses the exact name 'Desmond Richard'. Travel Weekly lists 'Richard, Desmond and Eleanor Maybury' as Big Bus Tours founders on the 2016 Rich List, so this record probably merges two brothers; please check which one the journalist means. No current role or public contact found for either.

name: Xie Yingbo
current_role: Co-founder and Chairman, Shanghai Titan Scientific (688133.SH)
profile: Xie Yingbo (谢应波), PhD, was technical director when six people founded Titan Scientific as a student startup in Oct 2007, and has been chairman since 2010. Titan is a one-stop lab-supplies company (reagents, consumables, instruments, lab build-outs, research software) with its own brands such as Adamas-Beta and the Tansoole e-commerce platform. It listed on the STAR Market in 2020.
interesting_fact: Titan was the first science/technology-services company listed on Shanghai's STAR Market (2020). It grew from a 6-person university-student startup backed by a RMB 200k 'Eagle Plan' (雄鹰计划) grant in 2007.
deep_cut_fact: The company's first outside money was a RMB 200,000 'Eagle Plan' grant for student entrepreneurs in 2007. In 2011 it was among the first firms to get Shanghai's tech performance-guarantee loan (科技履约贷), before equity from the Chuangye Jieli (Venture Relay) group.
notes: On Hurun China U40 (2021); listed age 44 in 2026. His role history is from Titan's disclosed resume via Eastmoney F10. General manager Zhang Qing is the more frequent media spokesperson.
